sections.purpose: Help parents book tutors without phone calls.
sections.journeys: A parent searches tutors, books a lesson, pays, and gets a reminder. A tutor sets weekly availability.
sections.requirements: Search by subject and level. Online payment. Reminders by email. Availability calendar.
sections.quality: GDPR compliant; pages load in under 2 seconds.
sections.scope: First release: search, booking, payment, availability. Excluded: video lessons, mobile apps.
sections.constraints: Runs on the platform's standard stack.
sections.research: Two competitors reviewed; payment provider feasible.
sections.acceptance: A parent can book and pay for a lesson in under three minutes. A tutor's availability blocks double booking.

stateFields.note: the project has several state fields (State, Stage); using 'State', the first in the project's order. Set STATE_FIELD to choose one
stateFields.hint: The planner and Factory read 'State', not 'Stage'. Set STATE_FIELD=Stage in youtrack/.env and recreate the planner. No field was detached or changed.
